finding: Required flags are inclusive; a request described as cached device-coherent VRAM can actually match a DEVICE_UNCACHED type. Earlier logs printed the preference, not selected flags. Correct logging without changing the allocator or synchronization contract.
measurement: Production read-only memory ledger plus norm/LO isolated production-shader fixtures whose inbox requires exactly the same device-local/host-visible/host-coherent/device-coherent bits; status remains ordinary coherent system memory. Q gtt-push payload remains system memory.
timing_control: Repeat independent shader tests with two timestamps per whole64-dispatch chain versus two timestamps per dispatch. Report actual between-dispatch barriers/reset costs included by chain timing; do not reinterpret them as hardware constants.
reference_policy: Do not sum two timing schemes, do not report cached/system fixtures as proven production brackets, and do not scale totals to observed model tok/s. Every change in the independent envelope must come from named measured components or source-derived counts.
safety: Only diagnostic metadata and standalone Vulkan test device features change; production selected memory type, visibility, barriers, epoch checks and timeouts remain unchanged.
